scope: Independent reading plus lexical/pattern checks of delivered source. No C# compile, Unity import, tests, scene loading, controller execution or host gameplay was run.

checks.description: All delivered C# delimiters and preprocessor guards are lexically balanced. This is not compilation.
Runtime and Editor files use the new versioned namespace; optional Tests~ references it.
Catalog has current package/schema/root GUID/Sprite GUID/fileID/SHA/metadata fingerprint.
Builder checks exact current manifest bytes against manifest_sha256.txt before source preflight or imports.

evidence.token: Current manifest bytes differ from manifest_sha256.txt.

checks.description: Builder validates actual Sprite/GUID/fileID/source-root identity and saves only the new catalog asset.
Importer is restricted to exact declared addon PNG paths; missing/unlisted files stay Default and errors have no legacy Sprite fallback.
Native Single/FullRect/PPU256/custom pivot and no mip/compression/NPOT scaling/automatic physics are explicit.
JSON schema rejects duplicate fields and missing required dimensions/ground/footprint/family/kind entries.
Cardinal4 and raw8-neighbor selectors use separate exact bits/paths and full-board same family/group/layer/height matching.
Every multi-cell footprint member is validated into a local plan, duplicate IDs/claims or rejected cells fail the complete snapshot.
Groups preserve one anchor and one renderer; no canvas/alpha/footprint fit to1cell.
Old owned sprites are hidden and cleared before deferred Destroy; empty snapshots replace with an empty owned set.
Null/new Configure attempts clear prior owned visuals and persist attempted config before validation, so stale art is not restored.
Inactive pre-Awake Configure+SetLayout is intentionally preserved; mere disabled/re-enabled objects cannot resurrect old layout.
Periodic posts require straight nodes and both along-line neighbours straight; phase is stable world-coordinate3/4, not frame Random.
Producer flower family/kind matches controller; accents sorted by exact path and selected by stable hash.
Controller/Planner never create colliders, change game transforms, poll input or advance gameplay in Update.
Row-down cell/group helpers and top-left origin adapter are explicit and arithmetically consistent.
Explicit catalog builds invalidate importer row cache before any PNG reimport, including copies retaining mtime/length.

optionalNUnitSource.reason: No Unity/dotnet/csc/mcs compiler installed and no actual project/test assembly supplied.
